verdict.rationale: Graphite documents one-click application of suggested fixes from the review page via Graphite Chat, and says AI reviews suggest fixes on every PR. However, the docs do not explicitly show that the review comments themselves carry committable suggested diffs; the one-click flow is described through Chat, on request. missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI/human review comments embed committable diff suggestions, description of how an applied suggestion is committed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments include committable suggested diffs I can apply with one click

citations.quote: Ask for suggested fixes and apply them in one click right from the review page.
Graphite Chat integrates directly with GitHub where you can take suggestions in 1-click.
AI reviews analyze every pull request in your repositories, identifying potential issues and suggesting fixes instantly
